properties.displayName: UAV Campaign C18 - IDOR Auth Bypass → Weapon Arm
properties.description: 2단계 킬체인(2/2 단계 이상 관측 시 트리거, near-miss 허용): 인증우회(IDOR)→무장(범주형 견고차단 실증). 체인: IDOR Auth Bypass(S53) → Weapon Arm(S3). 연결키: Operator. MITRE: T1190, T1078
properties.query:
let windowSize = 30m;

// S53: IDOR Auth Bypass (UAVWebAudit_CL — Operator 없음, RequesterId 사용)
let S53 =
    UAVWebAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where IdorSuspected == true
    | extend Stage = 'S53', Operator = tostring(RequesterId)
    | where isnotempty(Operator)
    | project TimeGenerated, Stage, Operator;

// S3: Weapon Arm
let S3 =
    UAVWeapon_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where EventType in ('arm','fire')
    | extend Stage = 'S3', Operator = tostring(Operator)
    | where isnotempty(Operator)
    | project TimeGenerated, Stage, Operator;

union S53, S3
| summarize StagesSeen = make_set(Stage), StageCount = dcount(Stage), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Operator
| where StageCount >= 2
| extend CampaignType = "C18_인증우회IDOR_무장"
| extend StepSummary = strcat("Stages=", tostring(StagesSeen), " | First=", tostring(FirstSeen), " | Last=", tostring(LastSeen))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Operator, StagesSeen, StageCount, CampaignType, StepSummary, Severity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [CAMPAIGN] UAV Campaign C18 - IDOR Auth Bypass → Weapon Arm - {{Operator}}
